```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r Project Setup}
# KIT-097: the structure of the lipidomics template (its params, the paths from the global project_dirs object, the
# figures and tables read from results_summary_dir, the analysis record overlay); the text is the transcriptomics
# analysis's own. Every value below is read from the analysis record or from the results summary.
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
if (!exists("project_dirs", envir = .GlobalEnv) || !is.list(get("project_dirs", envir = .GlobalEnv))) {
  stop("Global object 'project_dirs' not found or is not a list. Run MultiScholaR::setupDirectories() first.")
}
current_project_paths <- MultiScholaR:::getProjectPaths(omic_type = params$omic_type, experiment_label = params$experiment_label,
  project_dirs_object_name = "project_dirs", env = .GlobalEnv)
report_source_dir <- current_project_paths$source_dir
report_results_summary_dir <- current_project_paths$results_summary_dir
if (!dir.exists(report_results_summary_dir)) stop("Report results summary directory not found: ", report_results_summary_dir)
summary_file <- function(...) file.path(report_results_summary_dir, ...)
record_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "analysis_record.json")
if (!file.exists(record_path)) stop("The analysis record (analysis_record.json) is not beside study_parameters.txt: save the workflow arguments first.")
record <- jsonlite::read_json(record_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
# The record overlay the lipidomics template applies (KIT-031), with no study-parameter values of its own.
overlay <- MultiScholaR:::workflowRecordReportParameters(record_path, list(), list())
step_outcomes <- function(operation) {
  steps <- Filter(function(step) identical(step$operation, operation), record$steps)
  if (length(steps)) steps[[length(steps)]]$outcomes else list()
}
filter_outcomes <- step_outcomes("trx_expression_filter")
ruv <- step_outcomes("trx_ruvs")
da <- record$analyses$differential_abundance
model <- da$model %||% list()
export <- record$analyses$trx_ruviii_export
fdr_threshold <- overlay$s4_de_q_val_thresh %||% 0.05
value <- function(x, digits = 4) if (is.null(x)) "not recorded" else if (is.numeric(x)) format(round(x, digits)) else as.character(x)
show_figure <- function(path) if (file.exists(path)) knitr::include_graphics(path) else cat("Figure not available:", basename(path), "\n")
```

# Methods

## Filtering and normalisation

Genes were filtered with edgeR's filterByExpr on the TMM-scaled library sizes of the design's groups, and genes with zero variance across the samples were removed (`r value(filter_outcomes$genes_before)` genes before filtering, `r value(filter_outcomes$genes_after_filter_by_expr)` after filterByExpr, `r value(filter_outcomes$genes_after_zero_variance)` retained). TMM normalisation factors were computed with edgeR and log2 counts per million (prior count 2) were derived for the figures.

## Unwanted variation (RUVs)

Unwanted variation was estimated with RUVs (RUVSeq) on inferred empirical negative control genes: the least significant genes of a preliminary group-only quasi-likelihood GLM, taken at a chosen percentage of the filtered genes. They are inferred from the data, not known in advance. The selection mode was `r value(overlay$ruv_mode %||% ruv$ruv_mode)`; the grid tested `r value(ruv$percentage_min)` to `r value(ruv$percentage_max)` % in steps of `r value(ruv$percentage_step)` %, with k capped at `r value(ruv$max_acceptable_k)` and a k penalty weight of `r value(ruv$k_penalty_weight)`, choosing the maximum composite score. The chosen values were k = `r value(overlay$best_k %||% ruv$k)`, `r value(overlay$best_percentage %||% ruv$negative_control_percentage)` % of the genes, giving `r value(overlay$num_neg_ctrl %||% ruv$negative_control_count)` inferred empirical negative controls, with a separation score of `r value(ruv$separation_score)` and a composite score of `r value(ruv$composite_score)`.

The RUVs factors W_1..W_k were added to the design and used as model covariates in the differential expression model; the counts themselves were not corrected. The RUVs-corrected logCPM was used for display only (PCA and RLE figures).

## Differential expression

Differential expression was tested with the edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test: dispersions were estimated with estimateDisp (robust = TRUE), the model was fitted with glmQLFit (robust = TRUE), and each contrast was tested with glmQLFTest on that one fit. The realised model formula was `r value(model$formula_used %||% overlay$s4_formula_string)`. P-values were adjusted with the Benjamini-Hochberg method, and genes with a false discovery rate (FDR, BH) below `r value(fdr_threshold)` were called significant. No fold-change threshold was tested; fold-change lines in the figures are visual guides.

## Integration export (RUVIII)

```{r ruviii-text, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(export)) {
  cat("No RUVIII integration export was recorded for this analysis.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(paste("RUVIII (ruv::RUVIII) was applied to the TMM logCPM, with the RUVs inferred negative controls and k = %s, for the",
    "integration export only, with the replicate structure M taken from the %s. The differential expression results do not use it.\n"),
    value(export$outcomes$k), if (identical(export$outcomes$ruviii_m_source, "technical_replicate")) "technical replicates" else "group"))
}
```

# Results

## Normalisation

```{r cca-panels, fig.cap = "Canonical correlation panels of the RUVs control selection."}
show_figure(summary_file("Publication_figures", "canonical_correlation_panels.png"))
```

```{r stage-grid, fig.cap = "PCA and RLE of the raw, TMM and RUVs-corrected logCPM (the last for display only)."}
show_figure(summary_file("QC_figures", "normalization_comparison_grid.png"))
```

## Differential expression

```{r de-counts, results = "asis"}
tables <- list.files(summary_file("Publication_tables"), pattern = "^de_results_.+\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
for (path in tables) {
  de <- utils::read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)
  contrast <- sub("^de_results_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(path))
  cat(sprintf("For %s, %d genes were up and %d down at FDR (BH) < %s, of %d tested.\n\n", contrast,
    sum(de$FDR < fdr_threshold & de$logFC > 0), sum(de$FDR < fdr_threshold & de$logFC < 0), value(fdr_threshold), nrow(de)))
}
```

```{r volcanoes, results = "asis"}
for (path in list.files(summary_file("Publication_figures", "Volcano_Plots"), pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  cat(sprintf("![Volcano plot (-log10 FDR (BH)): %s](%s)\n\n", sub("^volcano_plot_(.*)\\.png$", "\\1", basename(path)), path))
}
for (path in list.files(summary_file("Publication_figures", "NumSigDeMolecules"), pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  cat(sprintf("![Significance summary: %s](%s)\n\n", sub("^summary_barplot_(.*)\\.png$", "\\1", basename(path)), path))
}
```

```{r top-genes}
top_path <- summary_file("Publication_tables", "top_de_genes.tsv")
if (file.exists(top_path)) {
  top <- utils::read.delim(top_path, check.names = FALSE)
  keep <- intersect(c("comparison", "regulation", "GeneID", "DisplaySymbol", "logFC", "FDR"), names(top))
  knitr::kable(top[, keep, drop = FALSE], digits = 4, caption = "Top up- and down-regulated genes per contrast (FDR (BH) < 0.05).")
}
```

## Integration export

```{r ruviii-figure, fig.cap = "PCA and RLE before and after RUVIII (the integration export)."}
show_figure(summary_file("QC_figures", "ruviii_before_and_after.png"))
```

```{r software}
software <- record$software %||% list()
rows <- Filter(function(x) is.atomic(x) && length(x) == 1L, software)
if (length(rows)) knitr::kable(data.frame(Item = names(rows), Value = vapply(rows, as.character, ""), row.names = NULL))
```
